description: This file defines the 'ModifyThingDefinitionResponse' class, which represents the response to a 'ModifyThingDefinition' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes static factory methods for creating instances based on JSON data, getters for accessing the response details, and overrides for JSON serialization, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: ModifyThingDefinitionResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to a 'ModifyThingDefinition' command, including status, thing ID, optional definition, and JSON serialization/deserialization logic.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a new definition was created, corresponding to HTTP 201 Created.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a definition was modified, corresponding to HTTP 204 No Content.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyThingDefinitionResponse instance.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions for this response, which is only V_2.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created or modified ThingDefinition, if present.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the JSON representation of the definition, if present.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path for the resource, specifically the definition path.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JSON object builder based on the schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with the specified DittoHeaders.
